newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks closes after surging to year high.
newsitem.headline: French stocks closes after surging to year high.

text.p: Merger fever and comments on the dollar from a Bundesbank official seen as benign for the franc hustled the bourse to a year high.

Traders said the UAP-Axa merger spurred the insurance sector and sent BNP, a major UAP shareholder, soaring. UAP and Axa will stay suspended until further notice. BNP welcomed the deal which will create one of the world's biggest insurers.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 23.93 points or 1.09 percent at 2,229.13, while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,243 from 2,210 on Friday's close.
